title: Welcome to the Journal
excerpt: A new space for behind-the-scenes notes, recent work, and the occasional piece of news — alongside the portfolio.

children.text: This is where I'll be sharing notes from recent shoots, thoughts on the work, and news as it happens — a slower, more personal companion to the portfolio.

title: Kujtimi (Remix) — filmed in the soul of Shkodër
excerpt: A short film shot across Shkodër — Gjuhadol, Kinema Republika, and its retro alleys.

children.text: Kujtimi (Remix) was filmed across Shkodër — Gjuhadol, Kinema Republika, and the city's retro alleys — chasing the particular light and texture of a place I know well.
